Jerry Yan Grazia September 2026 Issue Photos & Interview
Jerry Yan (@JerryYan) is a phenomenal idol representing the final generation before the golden age of print media came to an end.
Although industry communication is now entirely digitized, he has maintained his long-standing habit and wrote out all the answers for this interview by hand.

The shoot took place during a break after his concert tour concluded, and Jerry Yan candidly shared, "Since it's been a while since my last magazine interview, I wanted to approach it properly, so I wrote a lot."
The responses we received were written in Traditional Chinese, and his long-cultivated habits were evident in the punctuation and tone of the writing.
Simple and sincere, without flowery embellishments, every emotion he had kept hidden in his heart for years was written down.
The ups and downs of his more than 20-year career and the joys and sorrows of his journey are all condensed into simple yet powerful words.
